messages:
kevin: quick follow-up from the PM: we still have 5 actionable items. want to make owners explicit and avoid cascading handoffs. can we pick R/A and short ETA today?
nina: I can take ownership of the leader-election flake (R)  ticket SEV-9421. plan: reproduce, add a synthetic test, and propose fix. ETA Tue COB. A: priya, C: infra, I: kevin.
omar: i'll consult on the test harness. can you add acceptance criteria to the ticket (repro script + smoke run in CI)?
nina: added acceptance criteria: 1) repro script checked in; 2) CI synthetic test with <1% flake over 100 runs; 3) canary run shows no regressions.
priya: noted. i'll be the A and validate the canary. one process note: let's keep one R and one A per ticket. past threads had split acceptance and it slowed closures.
kevin: agreed. next item: memory bump mitigation for model-proxy (SEV-9455)  looks like a config mis-apply during deploy. who can own?
omar: I can pick SEV-9455. R: omar, A: nina, C: eng-sre, I: support. ETA Fri. I'll include a rollback playbook.
nina: please include a short verification checklist for Dedicated customers (latency and OOM rates).
omar: will do. adding labels `remediation` and `prod-impact`.
triage-bot: SEV-9421 assigned to nina; reminder 2026-04-05T09:00:00Z.
kevin: recurring-pattern item: DB slow-query tail (SEV-9400). this has repeated every ~6 weeks. propose we create an epic and centralize metrics + owner rotation.
priya: I volunteer to own the epic (EPIC-9800) and will run a 30-day mitigation plan. R: priya (epic), A: kevin. I'll create a weekly cadence to review evidence and status.
nina: can we add the historical incident list to EPIC-9800 so we can spot regressions?
priya: yes  linking historical tickets now and adding a short runbook section: root causes, mitigations, and who to escalate to.
omar: small ask  can we make the RACI doc reflect a "postmortem handback" lane? include owner rotation rules (2-week rotation, on-call exception) and clear acceptance criteria format.
kevin: good idea. priya, would you like to own the RACI doc update?
priya: I can. I'll submit PR with suggested text and examples: 1) single R, single A; 2) acceptance criteria field; 3) SLA for remediation (P1 3 days, P2 2 weeks).
nina: adding verification: please add an audit log step  who closed the ticket and timestamp. helps for compliance reviews.
priya: adding audit log requirement to RACI draft.
triage-bot: Follow-up sync created for 2026-04-06T10:30:00Z.
kevin: last ask  before we close, please add the exact PR link or config diff to the ticket so on-call can roll back quickly if needed.
omar: will attach PRs and a one-line rollback command to SEV-9455.
kevin: thanks all. marking this thread as 'followup: owners assigned'. reconvene on the sync. :thumbsup:
